title: Dynamic Paged Attention KV Cache Physical Offset Calculation
prompt: Implement a Python function `calculate_kv_offset(token_idx: int, head_idx: int, dim_idx: int, block_table: list, page_size: int, num_heads: int, head_dim: int) -> int` that maps a logical token, head, and channel index to its flat physical memory element offset within a paged KV cache table, assuming each physical page has contiguous tensor shape `[page_size, num_heads, head_dim]`.
target_invariant: Offset = physical_page * (page_size * num_heads * head_dim) + slot_in_page * (num_heads * head_dim) + head_idx * head_dim + dim_idx.
